The supplier has a copied Copper Sheets package-content/graphic label despite brass title, brass material field, brass description and golden main; this copy conflict is recorded and no supplier graphics or purity/alloy claims are imported. Walmart and the Unique Bargains BBB listing independently expose the same brass product family. ATEHNA sale quantity, model/specifications and inactive status are unchanged.
